ops.newText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data of Client and of its borrowers, loan applicants, customers and brokers (including Credit Data), and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment or transfer to TrueLink of any of the foregoing or creates any joint ownership therein, other than the license granted under Section 8(d). TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in any deliverables and work product created specifically for Client in the course of the Support Services, excluding TrueLink's Intellectual Property existing prior to or developed independently of such Support Services, in which TrueLink hereby grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property to the extent embedded in such deliverables for the purposes of Client's business.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a sentence confirming that Client keeps ownership of its content, intellectual property and borrower/customer data, and that Support Services deliverables are assigned to Client with a licence back to any embedded TrueLink IP; our playbook requires that we own what we pay for and what we put in, with no assignment or joint ownership of our data. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is untouched, and the existing Credit Data licence in Section 8(d) is expressly preserved.
input.summary: Add Client data/IP retention and Support Services deliverable assignment with licence-back to §2(d) Ownership.
